summary: Fix two confirmed release identity defects from v0.6.54 without changing the signed package gate or production services: exclude local build-control/description files from manifest and bind remote manifest/finalize to the immutable peeled tag commit. Follow-up: reject existing manifest tag/commit identity drift or malformed JSON before any sync upload.

components.owning_subsystem: GitHub Draft Release artifact identity and publication safety gate
components.disposition: Exclude hidden build-control files and generated Release body from local manifest. Resolve annotated/lightweight tag to its actual commit through GitHub commits/tag endpoint; never use moving Release.targetCommitish. Reject finalization when manifest commit differs from current tag commit, with zero Release mutation. On sync, fail closed with zero upload if an existing manifest is malformed, has a different tag, or has a commit_sha differing from the peeled tag commit (including legacy main).
evidence: At v0.6.54 Draft, GitHub Release.targetCommitish is literally main while v0.6.54 peeled commit is 7ecc0c4e31c96fd83f5f0643484546dae65df78b.
The local dist/.gitignore is not in the GitHub Release upload asset list, but collect_local_facts previously included it.
Five red-to-green negative cases prove sync rejects retargeted tags, legacy main/empty SHA, wrong manifest tag and malformed JSON without any Release mutation.
components.verification_level: Required gates: offline self-check, positive/negative regression tests, Ruff, independent managed GLM-5.3 Reviewer PASS/P0=0/P1=0 on the exact frozen SHA, original full R9 exit 0, exact-SHA GitHub PR/CI before merge.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Reject missing/invalid tag resolution, mismatched manifest tag commit, absent signed macOS package, asset SHA mismatch, or missing platform. Do not publish Draft or mutate already tagged v0.6.54. Existing manifest identity drift or malformed JSON must refuse sync with zero writes; never silently relabel old assets.
components.rollback_route: Revert this isolated three-path fix if review or tests fail; preserve existing v0.6.54 tag, Draft assets, Mac and Deepin production state.

g1.necessity: Release.targetCommitish can equal moving main; a mutable identity or a hidden build-control file in the authoritative manifest can produce an unpublishable or misidentified release. Exact immutable tag and upload-asset set are mechanically verifiable safety facts. A later retargeted tag must not silently relabel previously uploaded Draft assets during manifest sync.

g2.authority_owner: Existing repository release_finalize.py and GitHub annotated tag
g2.non_duplication: Reuse existing Draft/manifest/sha256/finalize gates and GitHub API; do not add a new publication authority, service or bypass.

g3.recovery_or_reason: When tag cannot resolve, return a fail-closed error without changing Draft. Reject finalization on manifest/tag commit mismatch. Reject sync when an existing manifest tag/commit is mismatched or malformed, with zero uploads; legacy invalid main-valued manifests require an explicit operator-authorized, audited removal/replacement of the stale manifest asset followed by fresh immutable-tag verification, never silent auto-repair.

g4.rollback: Revert only this three-file isolated patch; existing v0.6.54 tag/Draft and Mac/Deepin production are untouched.
